## Design

### 2026-10-01 — Today I started designing DeskOS, a tablet-sized touchscreen desktop companion. I defined the main purpose and interaction: the default screen will focus on currently playing media with album artwork,

**1.3h**

Today I started designing DeskOS, a tablet-sized touchscreen desktop companion. I defined the main purpose and interaction: the default screen will focus on currently playing media with album artwork, song information and playback controls, while a notification icon and count remain visible at the top. Tapping the notification icon will switch to a dedicated notification view. I also decided that DeskOS should receive notifications and media information from my phone and laptop instead of requiring separate integrations for every individual app. I created the initial GitHub repository and began planning the physical design, architecture and hardware requirements.
